title: Duplicate payments under concurrency
timezoneNote: times are UTC; sale ran afternoon Pacific

events.summary: Canary worker 1.8.14 promoted to 10% sale traffic. Change ticket BAY-1844. No config change to idempotency headers.
Flash-sale checkout rate rises. Merchant Harbor Bike Co clients begin retrying after 2000ms client timeout.
Alert DuplicatePaymentRateHigh: duplicate_payment_ratio > 0.5% for 3 minutes on sale-canary-1.
Ack page. Health endpoint UP. Error rate not in the paging path. Requests still returning 201.
Support ticket: customer Avery Chen charged 84.00 USD twice for invoice-8841. Idempotency-Key reported as harbor-8841 on both receipts.
Joins bridge. Asks for dashboard then logs. Notes production JPA path not yet receiving this canary’s traffic.
Stabilization proposed: remove sale-canary-1 from the load balancer. Not executed in this teaching timeline — student decides.

openQuestions: Are duplicates only on retries of the same key, or also on distinct keys?
Does the HTTP 201 pair share one correlation id or two?
Is the unique database key in play on this canary?
